scope: Finite opened-image coverage ledger for the twelve M1 source-form groups. No app operation by this audit.

groups.name: Lumberman cedar arch
limits: Three observed log axes are modeled; the fourth described log remains unresolved. Do not claim a measured four-log assembly.
The current close pair shows the three modeled members; the right end is partly crown-obscured. It does not supply the unresolved fourth member.

groups.name: Hollow Tree and Siwash
limits: Cavity and lookout/approach must be visible; bark, detailed braces and finished materials are later art.

groups.name: Brockton grounds and Totem precinct
limits: Eight display poles plus Yelton and two People portals have coarse forms. Southwest portal remains unplaced; rear pole and north portal estimates retain their bounds. Full visitor paving is not certified.

groups.name: Route sculpture silhouettes
limits: Coarse profile only; no carving, paint or exact sculpture reproduction. The People southwest portal source gap is shared with F03.
groups.specific_repeat: Original missing Girl assembly is retained; same-camera repeat resolves this view only. Harry head contact is visible in both current views. Exact cause of the transient Girl absence is not proved.

groups.name: Waterpark and Lumberman facilities
limits: Principal low boat/rock forms only. Actual pool operation and play equipment detail are later work. The nearest canopy proxies have measured plan gaps from the rock; no tree removal was justified.

groups.name: West coast beach spaces
limits: Third Beach top view proves roof shape, not a finished facade or every base contact. Second Pool layout and Air India wall/seat forms are visible. Inscriptions and detailed art remain later work.

groups.name: Lost Lagoon edge
limits: Nature House frontage/threshold repair is visible. Jubilee is structural massing without jets. Biofilter basin/bank is visible, with partial crown cover and a proxy water level.

groups.name: South park recreation grounds
limits: The high south overview shows court grid and recreation layout. Local golf greens and clubhouse have separate views. No detailed course or sport simulation claim.

groups.name: Gardens and public clearings
limits: Existing views show coarse bed, clearing and path forms; canopy hides some full perimeters. Greig is a broad envelope. Flowers, exact shrubs and small fixtures are later art.
The new garden views show local coarse extents/context, not complete garden layouts or species identity.

groups.name: Interior facilities and habitat
limits: Station roof/posts and rails are visible; Cob House wall/base/roof is partly crown-obscured. Salmon basin has a proxy water patch. Heron habitat is linked existing canopy/land context; no distinct nest or fauna was claimed. Non-player railway bridge/tunnel detail remains later work.

groups.name: Harbour edge and entrances
limits: Island roofs, park landforms and shore projections are visible. Devonian and other pond surfaces remain explicit level proxies. No invented landmark or monument was added for an ID.

groups.name: Distant built silhouettes
limits: Port View shows harbour/downtown context and North Shore sheds/silos/crane/mountains are readable. Distance models use separate source-height assumptions. No detailed city or unrelated access simulation claim.
The v27 r3 paired view shows central towers beyond beach/water; left and lower silhouettes remain partly crown-obscured. It does not accept every building.

policy: The original task requires named views and visual checks. It does not require every small asset in every application or production detail at M1. Recorded partial visibility remains explicit; a saved capture alone is not a review.
measurement_decision: User permits recorded width/gate/underpass estimates and accepted M1 with absolute accuracy unverified. This is not a blanket waiver of visible missing forms or contact defects.
reference_period: See manifests/m1-reference-period.json: measured 2022 environment, separately dated access overlay. Unanswered forest question withdrawn by planning amendment, not approved.

regional_controls_outside_twelve_groups.remaining: None for this finite coarse view; partial crown and thin-hanger rendering limits remain.

historical_snapshot_note: Earlier evidence snapshots and per-feature source/art flags remain historical or limited in scope. Exact pre-completion files are saved under evidence/m1-status-before-completion/.
